title: MAXx FX, The Greatest Action Figure that Never Was
content: Last week I had the privilege to visit my friend Mel Birnkrant, who showed me his original prototypes forMAXx FX, an action figure who dons movie-monster prosthetics to become the Werewolf, Mummy, Jason, Freddy, Swamp Creature, and Caveman.Link to my new YouTube videoRead thestory of MAXx FX on Mel's website(Link to 12-minute YouTube video)
